name: Bourdon
description: The bourdon — the heaviest bell in the tower, and the slowest to stop ringing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 36%; height: 36%; margin: 32%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: @m2(0 0 0 calc(@n * 5px * 6 / @size-col) @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
